supervision.title: What is Commercial Supervision?
supervision.description: Commercial Supervision, also known as trade inspection, is the process through which goods and the means interacting with them are inspected throughout their different movements, including land, maritime, and air transportation, as well as containers, factories, and warehouses.
supervision.description1: This service is carried out by certified or accredited international agencies acting as independent third parties, in accordance with agreements established between buyers and sellers in international contracts.
supervision.note: Unlike Quality Control, which is performed during the manufacturing process by the producer, Commercial Supervision is applied to goods ready for shipment, verifying that they comply with the agreed conditions prior to dispatch.

objective.title: Objective of Commercial Supervision
objective.description: To verify, through visual inspection, counting, measurement, sampling, and laboratory analysis, that goods are delivered according to the parameters and specifications established in international sales contracts, while also ensuring that the means used for their transport or preservation comply with agreed requirements.

laboratorio.headline: Service Unit
laboratorio.title: Quality Supervision Laboratory
laboratorio.description: CUBACONTROL S.A. Quality Supervision Laboratory is an independent unit specialized in quality analysis of import and export goods. It performs physicochemical, microbiological, and sensory testing following current Cuban and international standards.
laboratorio.certDescription: The laboratory has equipment that meets the specifications of NC ISO/IEC 17025:2017. It has Near Infrared Spectroscopy (NIR FOSS) for physicochemical testing and holds an environmental license for activities with biological risks and hazardous waste handling.

p1.title: A Company with State-Guided Autonomy and Responsibility
p1.description: Servicios Internacionales de Supervisión CUBACONTROL S.A. is a mercantile society that operates with controlled autonomy in its economic, financial, organizational, technical, productive, commercial, labor, and contractual management, in full compliance with the regulations established by the Government and the State.

p2.title: Origins and Legal Incorporation
p2.description: CUBACONTROL was founded on September 4, 1961, as one of the pioneering companies under the Ministry of Foreign Trade, tasked with carrying out commercial supervision activities. It was incorporated as a Cuban mercantile society under the name Servicios Internacionales de Supervisión CUBACONTROL S.A. Its registration is recorded in Book 161, Folio 05, Page 1632, Second Section, First Entry of the Central Registry of Corporations; and in Folio 05, Page 6714 of Book 669 of the Second Mercantile Registry of Havana, thus continuing the activities of the original CUBACONTROL company without interruption.

p3.title: Organizational Transformation
p3.description: Through a certificate issued by the Secretary of the Council of Ministers and its Executive Committee, dated September 27, 2004, the agreement of the Executive Committee of the Council of Ministers was notified, approving that the company S.I.S. CUBACONTROL S.A., from the Ministry of Foreign Trade, begin the implementation of Business Improvement.

p4.title: International Recognition and Certification
p4.description: It is a certified and accredited International Agency, operating in accordance with the requirements of NC-ISO 9001:2015, providing commercial supervision services through the inspection of goods and of the means with which they come into contact throughout their different stages—from the warehouse of origin to the first wholesale warehouse at the final destination. This supervision includes the various types and modes of transportation involved, such as land, maritime, and air transport, as well as containers, factories, warehouses, and other related environments. From its establishment until 2016, S.I.S. CUBACONTROL S.A. operated under the authority of the Ministry of Foreign Trade (MINCEX). In that same year, it became part of the Higher Organization of Business Management (OSDE) CAUDAL S.A. Due to the social impact of the services it provides, S.I.S. CUBACONTROL S.A. is structured to generate a minimum level of profit in its operations and, as a fundamental principle, will never operate at a loss.

insuranceDetails.title: Life Insurance
descriptions: Intended for Cuban nationals or foreign nationals with permanent residence in the national territory who meet the insurability requirements and are between 18 and 77 years of age.
Its main purpose is to mitigate the financial insecurity resulting from the death of the insured from any cause, thereby ensuring protection for the family’s financial stability.

Additionally, it covers temporary disability caused by accidents, cardiovascular diseases, cerebrovascular diseases, and emergency surgical interventions; permanent total or partial disability resulting from the previously mentioned events, as well as those caused by cancer and diabetes; pharmaceutical expenses incurred by the insured to recover from the effects of the risks covered by the policy; and funeral expenses incurred by family members. It may be contracted under the following modalities: individual, collective, and optional collective.

insuranceDetails.title: Travel Insurance Abroad
descriptions: This product is designed for Cuban citizens and foreign nationals with permanent residence in the country who travel abroad. With travel insurance abroad, we guarantee coverage for the following risks: medical expenses, repatriation and/or transportation of sick or deceased persons, civil liability, advance bail bond, assistance for loss of documents or luggage, as well as the transmission of urgent messages. Its validity corresponds to the duration of the trip.

insuranceDetails.title: Motor Vehicle Insurance
descriptions: Provides a voluntary insurance policy aimed at compensating damages caused to insurable land motor vehicles, regardless of brand, model, or year of manufacture. The basic coverage is Material Damage, and the client must contract at least one of the following risks: fire, lightning, explosion, collision or rollover, transportation, or comprehensive coverage.

It may be contracted by any Cuban, foreign, or stateless natural person residing in the national territory under any of its three modalities: one based on indemnification, another that considers indemnification and replacement of the damaged asset, and a final all-risk modality.

insuranceDetails.title: Civil Liability Insurance
descriptions: This product covers five Special Civil Liability Conditions: for holders of a Driver’s License; for road freight transport services; for passenger road transport services; for transport services using self-propelled or animal-drawn vehicles; and Mandatory Civil Liability for Professional Drivers, established by Decree-Law 11/2020, which is mandatory for all professional drivers.

These coverages protect the insured against civil liability imposed by final court judgment arising from death or injury caused to third parties, as well as damage, loss, or deterioration of third-party property caused by a vehicle when driving on public roads or during the provision of transportation services.

insuranceDetails.title: Fire Insurance
descriptions: This product is intended for clients who wish to protect their real estate (buildings and facilities) and their contents (furniture, machinery, equipment, utensils, household items, and other existing assets) against material damage or losses that may occur as a result of fire, lightning, explosion, and other additional coverages. For those wishing to insure their home, special conditions are established in the policy. It may be contracted by all natural persons or foreign residents.

insuranceDetails.title: Agricultural Property Insurance
descriptions: This insurance may be contracted by individual farmers and Credit and Services Cooperatives (CSS), covering damages or losses to short-, medium-, or long-cycle crops, based on their costs or expected yields, as a result of risks such as cyclones, strong winds, floods, heavy rains, excess humidity, hail, drought, fire, landslides, pests, and diseases, among others.
Contracting agricultural property insurance is an effective way to minimize the negative consequences of these events, ensuring financial peace of mind and the continuity of productive activities.

insuranceDetails.title: Livestock Insurance
descriptions: Covers the death and mandatory slaughter of animals, as well as the loss of their capacity to fulfill the purpose for which they were intended. This product covers the negative consequences of climatic risks, diseases, and accidents affecting animals covered by the insurance contract. It also covers suffocation, pathological birth, bloat, and surgical and post-surgical complications, provided that such procedures have been performed by veterinary personnel. It may be contracted by individual farmers and Credit and Services Cooperatives (CSS).

warehouse-management.title: Warehouse Management and Supervision Services
warehouse-management.description: Specialized service focused on the comprehensive supervision and evaluation of warehouses and logistics facilities, ensuring qualitative and quantitative control of goods and compliance with technical, structural, organizational, and safety standards. Includes supervision of climate-controlled storage, logistics processes, facility protection, and technical consulting for warehouse certification and classification.
items: Inventory supervision in factories and warehouses
Technical and operational evaluation of logistics facilities
Supervision of structural and organizational requirements
courses: Cursos concebidos como un programa didáctico, basados esencialmente en las normas obligatorias del reglamento existente.
Los cursistas alcanzarán su máximo nivel, acerca de las actividades y operaciones logísticas de almacenes de las entidades que operan en la economía del país.

insurance-agent.title: Insurance Agency Services
insurance-agent.description: Authorized by the Insurance Superintendency, SIS Cubacontrol S.A operates as an insurance agent providing comprehensive personal and corporate insurance solutions, including life, travel, automotive, liability, fire, and coverage for agricultural and livestock assets.
